content:
eva_support: Customer report: tool call failing with "invalid JSON" error when attaching file. They sent a payload that includes single quotes and a trailing comma which breaks our JSON parser.

sam_engineer: can you paste the raw request body and Content-Type? Also customer id.

eva_support: raw body (they set Content-Type: application/json):

```
{"tool_call": {"name": "upload_doc", "arguments": "{'url': 'https://s3.amazonaws.com/bucket/report.pdf', }"}}
```

matt_runtime: two issues: (1) arguments is a quoted string containing single-quoted JSON (invalid for JSON.parse), (2) trailing comma after the last property. Our parser expects arguments to be an object, not a string. This will always throw SyntaxError: Unexpected token '.

ana_sre: what does the runtime return to the client? Is it a 400 or 500?

ops-bot: runtime logs: `toolparser.parse_error: invalid_tool_args: Unexpected token ' in JSON at position 28`

sam_engineer: immediate customer guidance:
- Send `arguments` as a real JSON object (no outer quotes).
- Use double quotes for JSON keys/strings.
- Remove trailing commas.

Correct example we sent them:

```
{"tool_call": {"name": "upload_doc", "arguments": {"url": "https://s3.amazonaws.com/bucket/report.pdf"}}}
```

eva_support: customer confirmed the corrected payload worked (:thumbsup:). I also gave them a curl example and warned about copying JSON into single-quoted shells.

matt_runtime: follow-up: file ENG-7892 to improve error message when `arguments` is a string or JSON5 that's invalid. Instead of a generic SyntaxError, return 400 with message: "tool_call.arguments must be a JSON object using double quotes; do not pass a quoted JSON string or use single quotes/trailing commas." Assigned to @matt_runtime.

ana_sre: add a unit test for stringified-arguments and a regression test for trailing commas.

eva_support: closing thread — customer happy. Will reopen if they see similar failures.
